title: Hybrid and Multi-Cloud Connectivity: VPN & Interconnect — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Maps Hybrid and Multi-Cloud Connectivity: details Cloud HA VPN 99.99% dual tunnels, Dedicated Interconnect, and Cloud Router dynamic BGP routing.
routing_rationale: Enterprise hybrid networks combine high-bandwidth Dedicated Interconnect with encrypted Cloud HA VPN backup tunnels, synchronized via dynamic BGP.

nodes.label: On-Prem Core Router
nodes.detail: Enterprise border router with dual redundant physical cross-connects.

nodes.label: Corporate Subnet
nodes.detail: Internal corporate workstations and legacy databases.

nodes.label: Dedicated Interconnect
nodes.detail: Direct fiber cross-connect into Google colocation facility (99.99% SLA).

nodes.label: Cloud HA VPN (Dual Tunnels)
nodes.detail: Encrypted backup tunnel running across public internet with dual active interfaces.

nodes.label: Cloud Router (BGP)
nodes.detail: Exchanges BGP routes with on-prem; sets MED=100 for Interconnect, MED=200 for VPN.

nodes.label: Private Cloud Workload
nodes.detail: Google Cloud resources receiving low-latency hybrid packets.

steps.title: BGP Route Exchange
steps.action: Cloud Router and corporate router exchange routes dynamically via eBGP.
steps.why_traversal: Dynamic BGP eliminates manual static route updates and supports instant failover.

steps.title: Primary Interconnect Ingress
steps.action: Packet traverses Dedicated Interconnect with 100Gbps line rate and <3ms latency.
steps.why_traversal: BGP MED (Multi-Exit Discriminator) prioritizes lowest-cost Interconnect link over VPN.

steps.title: Standby Readiness
steps.action: Cloud HA VPN keeps BGP session active in standby mode, ready for instant switchover.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees 99.99% enterprise network SLA across physical disaster scenarios.

scenarios.label: Primary Interconnect Physical Fiber Cut
scenarios.root_cause: Metropolitan construction severs physical fiber cross-connect into Google colocation facility.
scenarios.diverted_path: BGP keepalive timeout (3s) withdraws Interconnect route; traffic instantly diverts to Cloud HA VPN.
scenarios.blast_radius: Sub-second session failover; bandwidth drops from 100Gbps to 3Gbps IPsec ceiling.
scenarios.recovery: Enterprise traffic continues uninterrupted; fiber technicians repair cross-connect.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
